prompt: Split a list of integers into evens and odds with Collectors.partitioningBy, so the returned map always has both Boolean keys. Complete evensAndOdds in Partitioner, then run the tests.
explanation: partitioningBy is the two-bucket special case of groupingBy: it takes a predicate and produces a Map<Boolean, List<T>>. Unlike groupingBy, it guarantees both the true and the false entry exist even when a bucket is empty -- which is why the tests can call get(true) on an all-odd input and still receive an empty list rather than null. n % 2 == 0 correctly classifies 0 and negative evens too, since -4 % 2 is 0 in Java.
hints: The whole body is one statement: nums.stream().collect(...).
The predicate for evenness is n -> n % 2 == 0 -- it also works for 0 and negative numbers.
